train_domain: Neutral Q0 multiplicity1 organic monomers containing C/H; reference graph assay passes and capped geometric MST lies in the open radial support.
angular_speed_cap: pi; contains the conditional mean of all short-geodesic teacher angular velocities
coupling: Proper source rotation alignment plus independent shared Haar augmentation. No type permutation that changes the fixed geometric scaffold.
source: Same learned normalized heavy-core degree prior and exact capacity-preserving terminal allocations; same truncated-lognormal radial source and uniform directions. Geometric MST teacher is derived from coordinates; no chemical bond-order labels.
loss: Same oriented-edge vector metric. Cartesian teacher is B*(X1-X0)/ell. Product teacher is dy*u+du, with linear radial logits and short spherical geodesics; node-vector output parameterizes chart velocities.
projection_control: Deterministic final tree-edge radial clipping of the Cartesian outputs, preserving their edge directions. Reuses exactly those neural draws; zero additional neural evaluations.
primary: Product-space trained model versus Cartesian-trained model and its physical final projection. Same learned prior, conditional network capacity, training examples/updates and128 neural evaluations per sample.
pilot_gate: Manifold graph-rate point improvement over Cartesian AND Cartesian-projected in both training seeds, pooled paired95 lower bounds positive over both, and no >2pp loss in distinct connectivity per attempted draw versus projected. Connectivity guarantee alone does not pass the learned-method gate.
failure_rule: No post hoc interval/degree-cap/solver/LR/budget sweep or best-seed selection based on this panel. All failed attempts and all controls retained.
scope: Reused12-composition monomer development panel, with entirely new model/source streams and a matched training subset. No untouched-test, absolute final-density, chemical-validity guarantee or Boltzmann-law claim.
